articles.title: Sheppard Takes 107K SF at In-Rel’s D.C. Redevelopment
articles.narrative: Law firm Sheppard has signed an anchor lease for 107,224 square feet at In-Rel Properties' 2033 K Street NW, a planned trophy office redevelopment in Washington, D.C. The firm will occupy space in the building, which is undergoing a significant expansion and modernization, upon its anticipated completion in July 2029. This lease highlights the ongoing trend in D.C.'s office market where demand for large, high-quality trophy spaces remains strong despite overall market distress, particularly from prominent law firms seeking modern and efficient workplaces.

data_points.notable_features: Trophy office redevelopment retaining existing concrete structure while adding three floors and a penthouse.

articles.title: Eliot Spitzer Gains State Approval to Redevelop 985 Fifth Avenue After Legal Bout
articles.narrative: Former New York Governor Eliot Spitzer has received state approval to proceed with the redevelopment of 985 Fifth Avenue, following a successful lawsuit against the state's Division of Homes and Community Renewal (HCR). This approval allows Spitzer to not renew rent-stabilized leases, a critical step for the demolition of the existing 25-story rental property and the construction of luxury condominiums. The project, designed by SLCE Architects, is slated to feature 25 condo units.

data_points.address: 985 Fifth Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Redevelopment of a 25-story rental property into luxury condominiums.
data_points.project_notes: Approval to not renew rent-stabilized leases was granted after a two-year request and a lawsuit against the state. The New York City Landmarks Preservation Commission approved demolition in 2023.

articles.title: OCVibe Adds Five Dining Concepts to $5B SoCal District
articles.narrative: The Samueli family has added five new dining concepts to Katella Commons, a 50,000-square-foot market hall within the $5 billion OCVibe mixed-use development in Anaheim, CA. The market hall, which will feature 21 kitchens, is expected to open in early 2027. OCVibe is taking an unconventional approach to leasing by fronting the initial investment for each stall, averaging $300,000, and providing operational support, aiming to reduce the financial burden on independent chefs and foster a more sustainable tenant environment. This strategy is part of a broader effort to establish OCVibe as a year-round destination, leveraging its diverse residential, office, hotel, and entertainment components to ensure consistent customer traffic.

data_points.notable_features: Part of a 100-acre mixed-use district surrounding the Honda Center, designed to be a year-round destination with residential, office, hotel, and entertainment components.
data_points.project_notes: OCVibe is fronting the initial investment for each stall, averaging $300,000, and providing ongoing operational support, including kitchen equipment, to reduce upfront costs for tenants. The overall OCVibe district is expected to be completed in 2033.

articles.title: The New School Sells Loeb Hall Residence to Hawkins Way Capital for $52M
articles.narrative: Hawkins Way Capital has acquired Loeb Hall, a 268-bed student residence hall near Union Square in Manhattan, from The New School for $51.5 million. This marks Hawkins Way Capital's third student housing acquisition in Manhattan this summer, demonstrating its strategy to expand its Found Study student housing platform. The property will undergo renovations and be repositioned to provide high-quality accommodations in a strong urban student housing market.

data_points.address: 131-135 East 12th Street, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Located four blocks east of The New School's main University Center.
data_points.project_notes: The property was previously used as a dormitory by The New School but was removed from its undergraduate housing options this year. It will be repositioned under Hawkins Way Capital's Found Study student housing platform.

articles.title: Fifth Third, CB&T TruAmerica Lend $124M on Bay Area Apartments Build
articles.narrative: SummerHill Apartment Communities has secured $123.5 million in construction financing for a new 251-unit multifamily project in San Carlos, CA. The financing package includes a $96.5 million senior construction loan from Fifth Third Bank and California Bank & Trust, alongside a $27 million preferred equity investment from TruAmerica Multifamily. This development is TruAmerica Multifamily's inaugural preferred equity financing through its recently launched structured finance platform, reflecting the firm's expanded strategy as a residential investment management company. The project will include 38 affordable housing units and is strategically located to benefit from the Bay Area's robust technology and life science sectors, which are driving strong multifamily occupancy and rent growth.

data_points.address: 11 El Camino Real, San Carlos, CA
data_points.notable_features: Six-story development with 38 units designated as affordable housing, located 24 miles south of Downtown San Francisco.
data_points.project_notes: TruAmerica Multifamily's first preferred equity financing since launching a structured finance platform last year.

articles.market_intelligence: The San Carlos submarket has a 97% multifamily occupancy rate and the region has experienced double-digit rent growth. The Bay Area multifamily market is outperforming, driven by return-to-office trends and the AI boom.

articles.title: Urban Story Ventures, Hill Partners to Develop $350M Mixed-Use District at The Bend in Chattanooga
articles.narrative: Urban Story Ventures and Hill Partners are collaborating on a new $350 million mixed-use retail and residential district within The Bend, a 120-acre redevelopment in downtown Chattanooga. The project, designed with an open-air layout, will feature a mix of restaurants, shops, service retailers, offices, and residences. Construction is slated to begin next year, with completion anticipated by fall 2028, contingent on preleasing activity.

data_points.notable_features: Open-air layout with restaurants, shops, service retailers, offices, and residences, inspired by The Wharf in Washington, D.C., and Biltmore Village in Asheville, N.C.
data_points.project_notes: Part of a larger 120-acre mixed-use redevelopment; construction expected to begin in 2027.

articles.title: FRP, Woodfield Begin Vertical Construction on Mixed-Use Development in Southwest Florida
articles.narrative: FRP Development Corp. and Woodfield Development have commenced vertical construction on the initial phase of a mixed-use project in Estero, Florida. This phase will deliver 296 apartments and 30,000 square feet of retail space, with tenant move-ins anticipated by the third quarter of 2027. The developers recently secured an $81.5 million construction loan from Santander Bank for the project.

data_points.total_project_all_phases: 600 apartments, 80,000 SF retail, 20,000 SF office, 190-room hotel
data_points.notable_features: Amenities include a resort-style pool, gaming lounge, coworking facilities, fitness center, and a sky lounge.
data_points.project_notes: The development will ultimately include 600 apartments, 80,000 square feet of retail, 20,000 square feet of offices, and a 190-room boutique hotel.

articles.title: ANF Tops Out Luxury Seniors Housing Community in Delray Beach, Florida
articles.narrative: ANF Group Inc. has topped out All Seasons Delray, a luxury senior living community under development in Delray Beach, Florida. The project, developed by Beztak, will offer 153 units, including independent and assisted living residences, with completion anticipated in the first quarter of 2028.

data_points.notable_features: Amenities will include a swimming pool, landscaped courtyard, pub, theater, library, game room, fitness center, pottery and arts studios, multipurpose activity spaces and an onsite medical center.
data_points.project_notes: Construction began in late 2025. The community will feature 92 independent living apartments and 61 assisted living residences.

articles.title: Cooking Oil Importer Signs 100,002 SF Industrial Lease in Chesapeake, Virginia
articles.narrative: Ciuti International LLC, a specialty cooking oil importer and packager, has signed a 100,002-square-foot industrial lease at Diamond Hill III in Chesapeake, Virginia. This facility will serve as the company's first operation in Virginia, strategically located near the Port of Virginia.

data_points.notable_features: Located approximately six miles south of the Port of Virginia.

articles.title: Elevation Land Co., Crow Holdings Capital Complete Phase I of Otay Business Park in California
Limited supply, strong demand boosts Chicago-area multifamily sector
articles.narrative: Chicago's multifamily market continues to demonstrate robust performance, with strong demand and rising rents, according to Cross Street's Q2 2026 report. The city's average effective apartment rent increased 4.3% year-over-year to $1,974 per unit, while the vacancy rate held steady at 4.4%. This strength is attributed to a relatively modest supply of new units compared to demand, keeping vacancy rates below the national average and supporting rent growth. Adaptive reuse projects are becoming a significant source of new apartment supply, particularly in downtown Chicago, where they are expected to account for nearly 44% of all units delivered this year.

data_points.notable_features: Adaptive reuse projects are a significant source of new apartment supply, especially in downtown Chicago.

articles.market_intelligence: Chicago's multifamily market is characterized by limited new construction relative to demand, which is supporting above-average rent growth and favorable long-term fundamentals. Concessions are declining in both downtown and neighborhood submarkets. Monthly leasing activity exceeded 2025 levels throughout the first half of 2026. While other markets face challenges from new apartment construction, Chicago's limited supply is an advantage.

articles.title: CBRE closes $11 million refinance for office property in Edina
articles.narrative: CBRE Capital Markets secured an $11 million refinancing loan for Grandview Square, a fully leased Class-A office property in Edina, Minnesota. The five-year, fixed-rate, interest-only loan was arranged on behalf of Capital Partners. The property's recent renovation and strong tenant occupancy underscore its appeal in a well-connected, amenity-rich district.

data_points.notable_features: Class-A office property located in the walkable Grandview district, offering amenities such as heated underground parking, a fitness center, golf simulator, and tenant lounge. Renovated in 2025, it provides convenient access to downtown Minneapolis and the airport.

articles.title: Northmarq closes $31 million multifamily sale in Sheboygan
articles.narrative: Northmarq's Midwest Investment Sales team facilitated the $31 million sale of Harbor Estates, a 186-unit garden-style multifamily community in Sheboygan, Wisconsin. The property, built in 2002, was sold by a partnership between Harmoniq Residential and Midloch Investment Partners. Its strategic location near Lake Michigan, major employers, and highly-rated schools, combined with a strong amenity package, positions it for continued investment performance.

data_points.notable_features: Garden-style community with one-, two-, and three-bedroom units, clubhouse, fitness center, putting green, underground parking, and a resort-style swimming pool. Convenient access to Lake Michigan, major employers, retail, dining, entertainment, and highly rated schools.

articles.title: Southfield’s REDICO launches healthcare investment and operating platform
articles.narrative: REDICO, a Southfield, Michigan-based real estate firm, has partnered with One Orchard to launch InfraMed Properties, a new healthcare infrastructure investment and operating platform. InfraMed will focus on acquiring, developing, owning, leasing, and managing medical outpatient properties nationwide. The platform is launching with a 25-asset portfolio across 16 states, anchored by credit-backed tenants affiliated with leading health systems, and aims to achieve over $1 billion in investments through programmatic equity and debt financing.

data_points.project_notes: InfraMed Properties is structured to acquire, develop, own, lease, and manage medical outpatient properties across the United States.

articles.title: Burlington, Planet Fitness leases bring Chicago’s Joffco Square retail center to 100% occupancy
articles.narrative: Nassimi Realty has secured two significant long-term leases with Burlington and Planet Fitness at Joffco Square in Chicago, bringing the urban retail center to full occupancy. Burlington signed a 10-year lease for 23,000 square feet, relocating to a more efficient format within the same trade area, while Planet Fitness committed to a 12-year lease for 22,000 square feet, entering the market to capitalize on local population growth. These transactions represent the successful completion of a major repositioning effort for the property, which was previously 50% vacant.

data_points.project_notes: Burlington's new store is expected to open in winter/spring 2027. Planet Fitness hopes to open in December 2026.

articles.title: Koeppel Rosen Arranges Three Office Leases in Midtown, Midtown South
articles.narrative: Koeppel Rosen recently facilitated three separate office lease transactions in Midtown and Midtown South, demonstrating continued activity in these key New York City submarkets. The deals involved a diverse set of tenants, securing space across different property types.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap Brokers Sale of 490-Unit Multifamily in St. Louis
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of Trinity Park Apartments, a 490-unit multifamily property in North St. Louis, through an online live bid auction. The property was marketed as a value-add opportunity due to its below-market occupancy, offering the new owner significant lease-up potential. The transaction involved investment specialists from Marcus & Millichap's Chicago Oak Brook, Indianapolis, and St. Louis offices, who represented both the seller and procured the buyer.

data_points.notable_features: Comprises 34 residential buildings with a mix of one-bedroom and two-bedroom residences.

articles.title: Hanover Company Launches Construction on Its First SoCal Industrial
articles.narrative: Hanover Company, in partnership with a real estate fund advised by Crow Holdings Capital, has commenced construction on its inaugural industrial development in Southern California. The project, located in Simi Valley, will deliver approximately 200,000 square feet of industrial space designed to accommodate various users, including corporate headquarters, packaging and assembly, or distribution. This marks Hanover Industrial's first venture into the Southern California market, establishing a presence in the dynamic Simi Valley area.

data_points.notable_features: Features 36’ clear heights, an 8.5” slab, skylights, and ample employee parking, with immediate proximity to CA 118.

articles.title: Associated Bank Finalizes Loan for Twelve-Acre Retail Project in OH
articles.narrative: Associated Bank has finalized a $9 million loan to GTZ Properties for the development of Trailhead Crossing, a multi-building retail project in Delaware, Ohio. The twelve-acre development will feature several freestanding buildings and a three-tenant strip, with a later phase planned to include a big-box national retailer. This transaction marks the 18th loan provided by Associated Bank to GTZ Properties' principal.

data_points.notable_features: Multi-building retail project with several national tenants and pad-ready sites.
data_points.project_notes: One pad-ready site is pending sale to a national daycare company. A later phase will be anchored by a big-box national retailer.

articles.title: Planet Fitness to Open at Sky Three Residences in West Brighton Beach
articles.narrative: Planet Fitness has secured a 14,520-square-foot retail lease at the base of Tower 3 within the Sky Three Residences in Brooklyn's West Brighton Beach. The new fitness center, expected to open in early 2027, will enhance the retail offerings along the Neptune Avenue corridor, complementing a diverse mix of existing tenants.

articles.title: Olympic Retail Users Taking Early Look At LA
articles.narrative: The upcoming 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles are anticipated to significantly increase demand for specific retail sectors. Retail tenants are reportedly beginning to explore opportunities to capitalize on the heightened activity and consumer interest surrounding the global event.

articles.title: MG Developer Faces 6 Lawsuits Alleging Millions In Overdue Debt
articles.narrative: MG Developer is currently facing six lawsuits alleging millions in overdue interest and equity payments. These legal challenges come as the developer actively works to maintain its industry reputation amidst financial disputes.

articles.title: Senior Housing Buyers Are Paying Up, But Sellers Still Need Convincing
articles.narrative: The senior housing market is experiencing a surge in investor demand, leading to increased pricing for available assets. However, despite the rising valuations, sellers remain hesitant, contributing to a constrained supply environment. This dynamic suggests a disconnect between buyer willingness to pay higher prices and seller expectations or motivations to divest.

articles.title: City Realty Buys Coolidge Corner Portfolio For $23M: The Boston Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: City Realty has acquired a nine-building portfolio in Brookline's Coolidge Corner from Ramon Realty for $23 million. The transaction was facilitated by Colliers.

articles.title: American Cancer Society Aims To Bring New Lodging To South Side: The Chicago Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: The American Cancer Society is planning to develop new lodging facilities in Chicago's Hyde Park neighborhood. This initiative aims to provide accommodation for cancer patients, with support from UChicago Medicine.

data_points.notable_features: Aims to provide lodging for cancer patients.
